usageNote: explore就是探索、游览，比visit更有冒险感！说去景点用visit也行，但explore听起来超酷👍

examples.en: We decided to explore the Jinshanling section of the Wall at sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们决定在日出时游览金山岭长城段。

examples.en: Exploring the Jinshanling section of the Wall gave us a real sense of ancient history.
examples.zh: 游览金山岭长城段让我们真切感受到了古老的历史。
